name: Anthropic
title: Anthropic stack overview
description: Everything Anthropic offers in one view: Claude models, apps, Claude Code and the Developer Platform, plus open standards, research, safety and programs.
answer: Anthropic builds AI research and products with safety at the frontier. It is a public benefit corporation and has been listed on Nasdaq since November 2026. Its main product family is Claude: models sold through the Claude apps, Claude Code and the Claude Developer Platform, and distributed through Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry. Around Claude, Anthropic created the MCP and Agent Skills open standards, publishes safety research and its Responsible Scaling Policy, and runs education, science and partner programs.

domains.label: Claude models
domains.tagline: The model families behind every Anthropic product.
domains.intro: Claude ships in tiers that trade capability for speed and cost. Fable is the most capable widely released line; Opus, Sonnet and Haiku cover the rest, and Mythos is released only to verified organisations.

domains.label: Claude Developer Platform
domains.tagline: The API, tools and admin surface for building on Claude.
domains.intro: Formerly the Anthropic API. One Messages API reaches every model, with server tools, agent infrastructure, context management and enterprise controls, sold direct and through AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft.

domains.label: Claude Code
domains.tagline: Agentic coding in the terminal, IDE, desktop, web and CI.
domains.intro: Claude Code reads a codebase, edits files and runs commands. It runs in many surfaces, is extended with plugins, skills, hooks and MCP, and can be governed centrally with managed settings.

domains.label: Claude apps
domains.tagline: Claude for everyday work, on every device and in the tools teams use.
domains.intro: The Claude app on web, desktop and mobile, plus Cowork for longer agentic tasks, creation tools, connectors into business apps, and the Team and Enterprise plans that govern them.

domains.label: Industry solutions
domains.tagline: Claude packaged for regulated and specialised sectors.
domains.intro: Sector bundles combine Claude with industry connectors, skills and agent templates, plus verification programs and public-sector procurement routes.

domains.label: Open standards & open source
domains.tagline: Protocols, runtimes and tools Anthropic created or maintains in the open.
domains.intro: Anthropic created MCP and Agent Skills and donated both to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation. It also owns Bun and publishes SDKs, cookbooks and open safety tooling.

domains.label: Research
domains.intro: Anthropic publishes research on how models work inside, how to keep them aligned, and how people use them. Teams include Interpretability, Alignment, the Frontier Red Team and Societal Impacts.

domains.label: Safety & policy
domains.tagline: The frameworks that govern how Claude is built, released and used.
domains.intro: The Responsible Scaling Policy, Claude's constitution, the Usage Policy and the Transparency Hub set out Anthropic's own rules. Security programs and regulatory commitments sit alongside them.

domains.label: Programs
domains.tagline: Economic research, science, learning and partner programs.
domains.intro: Programs that fund research, train people and grow the partner ecosystem, from the Economic Index and AI for Science to Claude Academy and the Claude Partner Network.

domains.label: Company & partners
domains.tagline: Who Anthropic is, how it is governed and who it works with.
domains.intro: Anthropic is a public benefit corporation with a Long-Term Benefit Trust, listed on Nasdaq since November 2026. Major cloud, compute and consulting partners distribute and deploy Claude.

faqs.question: What is Anthropic?
faqs.answer: Anthropic is an AI research and products company focused on safety, and the maker of Claude. It is a public benefit corporation overseen in part by a Long-Term Benefit Trust, and has been listed on Nasdaq as ANT since 19 November 2026.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Anthropic and Claude?
faqs.answer: Anthropic is the company. Claude is its family of AI models and the products built on them: the Claude apps, Claude Code and the Claude Developer Platform. Anthropic also maintains open standards, publishes research and runs programs that are not Claude products.

faqs.question: Which Claude model should I use?
faqs.answer: Anthropic's docs recommend Claude Opus 5.5 as the default. Fable 5.2 is the most capable widely released model, Sonnet 5.5 balances cost and capability, and Haiku 5.5 is the fastest and cheapest. All four have a 1M-token context window.

faqs.question: How much does the Claude API cost?
faqs.answer: Per million input/output tokens: Fable 5.2 $8/$40, Opus 5.5 $4/$20, Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10 and Haiku 5.5 from $0.10/$0.50. The Batch API halves these prices and prompt caching cuts the cost of repeated input.

faqs.question: What plans does Claude have?
faqs.answer: Free, Pro ($20/mo), Max ($100/mo) and Ultra ($200/mo) for individuals; Team at $25 or $125 per seat per month; Enterprise at $20 per seat plus usage; plus education, government and pay-per-token API pricing.

faqs.question: Where can I run Claude besides Anthropic?
faqs.answer: Claude models run on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform (Vertex AI) and Microsoft Foundry. Anthropic also operates its API through AWS and Google Cloud billing, and Claude is available inside GitHub Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Snowflake.

faqs.question: Does Anthropic train on my data?
faqs.answer: Not for commercial products. Inputs and outputs from the API, Team, Enterprise and government plans are not used for training, apart from explicit feedback. Free, Pro and Max users choose whether their chats can be used.

faqs.question: Can I keep Claude data in the EU?
faqs.answer: Not on Anthropic's first-party API, which offers global or US-only inference. For EU regional processing, use Claude through Amazon Bedrock or Google Cloud's Agent Platform, where the region is set by the endpoint.

faqs.question: Which certifications does Anthropic hold?
faqs.answer: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 42001 and CSA STAR Level 2 for the commercial products, plus a HIPAA BAA for Enterprise chat and the API. FedRAMP High is available through Claude for Government and the hyperscaler government regions.

faqs.question: Is Claude Code open source?
faqs.answer: No. Claude Code's licence is all rights reserved, with use subject to Anthropic's Commercial Terms, even though its repository is public. The Python wrapper of the Claude Agent SDK is MIT-licensed, and the client SDKs are Apache-2.0.

faqs.question: Who owns the Model Context Protocol?
faqs.answer: Anthropic created MCP in November 2024 and donated it to the Agentic AI Foundation, a Linux Foundation directed fund, in December 2025. Agent Skills followed in October 2026.

faqs.question: What is the Responsible Scaling Policy?
faqs.answer: Anthropic's framework that ties model capability thresholds to required safeguards. Version 3.4 took effect on 8 July 2026, and ASL-3 protections have applied to frontier models since May 2025.

faqs.question: Has Anthropic signed the EU AI Act Code of Practice?
faqs.answer: Yes. Anthropic is on the European Commission's list of signatories of the General-Purpose AI Code of Practice. Its trust centre also publishes model documentation forms.
